messages.text:
hey folks, to keep the conversation moving and to stay connected, i'm going to book in a meeting to go through the Movement Metric 'next-steps'. This will be where we can pin-down exactly what needs to be done to start utilising it internally. This will be a good place to level-set on Dion's/ Ramin's initial plans, current thinking and figure out how we (audience) can help out. In my mind, I want to start by easing it into our current weekly reports/ daily sheets to start making the editors more familiar with how we can use it for insights - I'll chat about this in more detail in the meeting.

We can also chat about Movement-IQ dashboard and how we can amend it based on the feedback received yesterday. When it comes to making the automated insights more 'actionable' and digestible, we (Audience team) can help you (<@U02GQL9QG9G> <@U05BV05GYQH>) out here a lot. I dont want to get ahead of myself, but I see the Movement-IQ dashboard the 'end-goal' for our internal usage, and there are many steps in between we need to do first.
I'm hoping we can put together a timeline for this all. Cheers :beers:
